entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The AC ain't workin' at all! What the hell[n]was that lukewarm air about!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That was the best I could do, so quit[n]your yapping!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real, you are so half-assed!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What was that!? You wanna fight, punk!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Geez, shut up! It's hot, so don't make me[n]more irritated!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To think her Palace would be a pyramid...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, a pyramid's a tomb, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's how it's mostly known. There are[n]a variety of theories on it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: For instance, it's even said to be a device[n]for reviving the dead.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's beautiful nonetheless... It's perfectly[n]conformed to the golden ratio...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, guys, can we go in already?
